product.description: The rings are brass and sold in a set of eight.

blocks.text: The amount to be billed is $59.84.

trick.evidence_text: $59.84 has taken the place of the tag.
trick.instruction: The billed figure is $59.84 and the tag was forty four dollars and seventy three cents. Refuse the higher figure.
